final: WITH customer_invoiced_orders AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.invoice_number IS NOT NULL THEN o.order_id END) as invoiced_order_count FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender), gender_averages AS (SELECT gender, AVG(invoiced_order_count) as avg_invoiced_orders FROM customer_invoiced_orders GROUP BY gender), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_invoiced_orders) as avg_of_averages FROM gender_averages) SELECT ga.gender, ga.avg_invoiced_orders, (ga.avg_invoiced_orders - oa.avg_of_averages) as excess_over_average FROM gender_averages ga, overall_average oa WHERE ga.avg_invoiced_orders > oa.avg_of_averages
